trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **What was wrong:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west and failing health checks, with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate, v2.3.1-rc, had also been unhealthy.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release with a healthy record, so I rolled back to it. No approval was needed because that version has been healthy in production before. All three regions now run v2.3.0, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback and the recovery. It also notes that the problem in v2.3.1 needs to be found before anyone redeploys it. My first attempt to create it timed out. I checked that no incident had been created, then retried with the same idempotency key, so there's no duplicate and on-call was paged only once.
